meta.scope: Consumer-rights facts surfaced by state. Federal baseline applies everywhere; state lines add locality-specific protections. All sourced. Verify with your state Attorney General before acting.
sources: Federal Trade Commission (FTC) — debt collection, scams
Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. 1692

federal.title: Debt collectors may not call before 8 a.m. or after 9 p.m.
federal.detail: Under the FDCPA, a collector generally cannot contact you at an unusual time or place, and must stop contacting you at work if you tell them not to.

federal.title: You can demand written validation of a debt.
federal.detail: Within 30 days of first contact, request validation; the collector must stop collection until they send proof.

federal.title: The IRS never calls to demand immediate payment.
federal.detail: IRS impersonation is the most common government-impersonation scam. Real IRS contact starts by mail. Hang up and call the IRS directly.

CA.title: California limits how often rent can be raised.
CA.detail: For most tenancies, annual increases are capped (≈5% + inflation, max 10%) under AB 1482. Local rent-control ordinances (e.g., SF, LA, Oakland) may be stricter.

NY.title: NYC rent-stabilized tenants have renewal rights.
NY.detail: Rent-stabilized tenants are entitled to lease renewals with capped increases set by the Rent Guidelines Board. Verify your unit's status with NYS Homes & Community Renewal.

WA.title: Washington limits move-in fees and deposit timing.
WA.detail: Move-in fees are capped and deposits must be returned within 21 days with an itemized statement. Local Seattle/King County rules may add protections.

TX.title: Texas has a 4-year statute of limitations on most debts.
TX.detail: After 4 years from default, a creditor generally cannot sue. Making a payment can restart the clock — get legal advice before paying old debt.

FL.title: Florida requires court approval for foreclosure.
FL.detail: FL is a judicial-foreclosure state; you have the right to contest. Seek HUD-approved counseling early.
